svg.aria-label: DoDAF OV-1 for DAF27TZ01-DV002: AutonomousTrust cohorts of smallsats, sUAS and ground IoBT sensors detect, demote and gate out a credentialed but compromised edge node without reach-back, with fog-tier gateways rolling reputation up the hierarchy.

text.tspan: · AIR AND SPACE FOG/EDGE FLEET UNDER CYBER ATTACK, CONTESTED (DDIL) · DAF27TZ01-DV002

svg.text: SMALLSAT COHORT — light-lag, intermittent ground contact
sUAS ISR COHORT — responds on its own
IoBT COHORT — sub-threshold quorum, capped admission
Detect — track 97.5 m off vs 50 m bound
Resident AT agent — every ringed node
SBIR/STTR DATA RIGHTS — use and disclosure restricted per the cover-page legend. TekFive, Inc.
DoDAF OV-1 operational-concept scene · illustrative — node set representative of the §4 demonstration; reputation values notional.
